Hi Katie — good news: we approved a 30-day, $2,500 playground allowance that you can activate yourself.

How to activate:
1) Open your Console and go to Account > Entitlements > Playground Allowance.
2) Click "Redeem one-time allowance" and enter code ZEP-PLAY-2311 (this code will appear in the Console activation dialog as well).
3) Once redeemed you should see the additional allowance applied to the playground billing bucket and your expiry will be extended by 30 days.

I've attached a one-page instructions PDF for the step-by-step (playground_allowance_instructions.pdf) and also included the Drive link if you prefer a copy there. If you hit any friction, reply here and I'll escalate to Ops to finish activation for you.

One small ask: please keep usage to development experiments (no production inference). We'll monitor for production traffic during the extension window.

Thanks and good luck with the POC — excited to see the results.

—Connor
